verses.1: A song for David, to be sung over the Gittit.
verses.2: Holy God, our Lord! How magnificent is your name throughout all the earth! You have given your glory to the heavens.
verses.3: From my mouth come words of comfort and healing. You have established a way for your enemies to be punished and healed.
verses.4: For I see your names written on the tablets of your deeds, along with stars and constellations that you have created.
verses.5: What kind of person is it that remembers us? And what kind of human being is it that takes care of us?
verses.6: And he lost a little from God’s favor and blessing. May God restore him.
verses.7: May they be destroyed by your hands. All that they have will be destroyed beneath their feet.
verses.8: Thousands and thousands of them, as well as the animals in the fields.
verses.9: The stars in the sky and the fish in the sea cross over the seas.
verses.10: Yehovah, our God, how great is your name throughout all the earth!
